extracted.intended_audience: educated readers interested in philosophy, education, aesthetics, and self-development (readers of Bergson/Hans Larsson)
extracted.subtask_description: Philosophical guidance and practical criteria for developing a personal (authentic) life, for education/mentorship, and for focused intellectual/artistic workspaces and practice. The text gives standards for how persons grow, how educators should act, and how scientific/artistic work should be organized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal life must be expressed in action
rubrics_metrics.description: Persoonallinen elämä ilmenee ensisijaisesti teossa; ei pelkästään maussa, tunteissa, katsomuksissa, arvosteluissa tai ihanteissa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only through continuous, intentional action does the personal life become real. Anti-patterns: remaining a theoretician, dreamer, or aesthete who admires changes in taste or opinion but does not act; failing to 'live' the personal self. To be fully human one must 'forge' one's fate with persistent acts, plan and lead one's development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overcoming past, habitual influences requires sustained will
rubrics_metrics.description: Herännyt minämme kohtaa vahvaa, persoonatonta menneisyyden vaikutusta — tottumukset, vaistot ja tavat pyrkivät hallitsemaan toimintaa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion for successful personal development: the awakened person must constantly and resolutely intervene to break old, automatized patterns. Anti-patterns: losing focus, slipping back into vegetative unreflective living, or giving up effort and returning to dreams and resignation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need for a true educator/mentor (kasvattaja)
rubrics_metrics.description: Persoonalliseen elämään herännyt ihminen tarvitsee kasvattajaa: elävää ihmistä, joka muuttaa tahdon voimiseksi, pitää valveilla, viitoittaa tien ja antaa tukea.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules or abstract instructions cannot replace a living mentor. The educator must be a full personality who strengthens, protects, cultivates and raises the awakened person without molding mere replicas. Anti-patterns: relying solely on directives, isolated self-teaching when inner resources are insufficient, or seeking mentors who produce clones rather than independent persons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educability depends on prior awakening
rubrics_metrics.description: Vain ne, jotka ovat 'heränneet' (joilla jotain on), voivat todellisesti kasvaa kasvattajan avulla; muut pitää ensin herättää.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educators should target those with some inner life/longing; continuous external stimulation (lectures, exhortations) can keep one awake temporarily but produces only made, non-original growth. Anti-patterns: attempting systematic moral or personal formation on individuals lacking any inner receptivity and expecting genuine personal creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education should not produce artificial copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Hyvä kasvatus muokkaa itsenäisiä persoonallisuuksia, ei muotteihin hakattuja jäljennöksiä omasta itsestä.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The mentor's work should preserve and nourish each person's originality and autonomy. Anti-patterns: pedagogues who impose their own personality, producing imitators rather than independent individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inner receptivity is the primary condition for receiving higher life-forces
rubrics_metrics.description: Elämänvoimat (jumalallinen elämänvirta) voivat täyttää ja ravita herännyttä henkilöä vain, jos tämä on sisäisesti vastaanottavainen ja oma alkuperäisyys herkistää kielistön kosketuksille.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Openness, sincerity, and a genuine inner craving for fulfillment matter more than intellectual belief; belief in God is presented as consequence rather than prerequisite. Anti-patterns: assuming doctrinal assent is necessary for spiritual empowerment; relying on mere intellectual or moral convictions without inner originality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concentration ('keskitys') is essential for scientific, artistic and practical work
rubrics_metrics.description: Keskitys on yleismaailmallinen laki: työ, taide ja tiede tarvitsevat eheän keskipisteen ja valintaa osien ja kokonaisuuden välillä.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful work requires selecting representative 'parts' (kastehelmet) that reflect the whole, simplifying and expressing ideas in few memorable laws or images. Anti-patterns: scattered attention, mechanical activity, or an overabundance of trivial details that obscure the main point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific work requires artistic synthesis and selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Tieteellinen työ on kokoilua, mutta se tarvitsee taiteellista työtä: aineiston hallinta, keksivä yhdistäminen ja suppea, mieleenpainuva ilmaisutapa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A good scientist expresses laws and key ideas in the simplest, most attractive and select form; imagination aids in discovering unifying thoughts. Anti-patterns: presenting excessive, unselected detail; failing to produce coherent, expressive formulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artistic work requires a clear central aim
rubrics_metrics.description: Taiteellinen työ ja toiminta tarvitsevat keskipisteen: jos päämääräksi asetetaan epäolennainen, tekojemme kompassi on levoton.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose an authentic main aim and let other actions align as if by a compass needle; this focused coherence produces artful results. Anti-patterns: aimlessness, setting trivial goals leading to scattered, restless activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workrooms and practice should balance intellectual and physical labor
rubrics_metrics.description: Modern työhuone needs both mental tools (books, pens) and, as refreshment, physical labor and contact with nature — examples: Tolstoi mixing writing and manual labor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate bodily work or natural renewal alongside intellectual effort to maintain vigor and groundedness. Anti-patterns: isolating intellectual work from life; attempting to transplant nature wholesale into the study as decoration rather than living practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid two dangers in the modern workroom: over-specialization and clutter
rubrics_metrics.description: Nykyajan työhuoneella on kaksi vaaraa: kiinnittyminen yksipuoliseen rajoitettuun alaan tai täyttyminen rihkamasta, joka estää näkemästä kokonaisuutta.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counterbalance specialization with artistic, holistic influences; counterbalance clutter with internal concentration and careful selection of representative, meaningful details. Anti-patterns: a cramped, over-decorated room that obscures vision; narrowness that blinds one to larger connections.

rubrics_metrics.name: True growth requires both suitable human material and external cultivation
rubrics_metrics.description: Parhainkaan kasvatus ei riitä ilman kelvollista ihmisainesta; vain jonkin verran elämänvoimaa olemuksessa mahdollistaa järjestyksellisen, tervehenkisen itsenäisen kasvun.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Education amplifies and shapes existing life-force but cannot fabricate deep, original personal energy from nothing. Anti-patterns: expecting systematic, full-fledged independence from students utterly lacking inner resources; overreliance on external methods to create spontaneity.
